intro.text: 11:58 pm. The quarterly report is still running.

intro.speaker: Ada
intro.text: Nobody reads these dashboards anyway. SQL is just... busywork.

intro.speaker: Ada
intro.text: I'll just close my eyes... until it reaches 100%...
The progress bar stops at 99%. So does Ada's heart.

intro.speaker: Ada
intro.text: Grass? Why is the sky a table? Why does it have so many columns?

intro.speaker: Grimoire
intro.text: Welcome to the Kingdom of Codd, witch. Here the world is a database, and magic is querying.

intro.speaker: Grimoire
intro.text: Your Grimoire. Write a query on my left page. Every row that names a spell will cast it.

intro.speaker: Grimoire
intro.text: But my right page holds only four rows. You pay for every spell you summon...

intro.speaker: Grimoire
intro.text: ...and only the rows you can read take effect.

intro.speaker: Ada
intro.text: So SELECT * is... a bad idea?
Something round and green wobbles out of the bushes: the ASTERISK SLIME!

battle_tip: Look first: SELECT * FROM enemies. CTRL+ENTER casts.
victory: The Asterisk Slime melts into a puddle of rows.
Ada: One word. LIMIT. And the page behaves.
defeat: Ada's HP hits zero. The Slime wobbles triumphantly.
Grimoire: Even the best witches overflow sometimes. Again?
